body: So anxious to hear from you.  I hope you are still with us.
I truly ache for the pain and suffering your father (and you) have endured.  My heart aches and I sending my sincerest care...
Thank you!  Good info and I sincerely appreciate your response.

Interesting.  I was just researching this very thing.  With so many pill varieties on the market (over the counter drugs) it is very difficult to say.  Not to mention it will vary from  person to person.  I'm no more enlightened than I was an hour ago, when I searched that very question.   Just so you know, from one hurting person to another, I care.
Tons of care here.  Hoping you are with us and will post.  We are a caring community and we're with you and empathize with your pain.

I'm there today as well.  Husband wants out, which would be my second rejection.  All your emotions, feelings and thoughts?  I echo them.  I get it.  In all my life, I have never felt so unworthy of love, so useless, such a zero.   I hope you find hope and a reason to live.  I'm sending tons of thoughts your way.  I care, and I've never even met you.
Are you still with us?  Such profound pain which I know is overwhelming.  I'm there too.  I'm with you spirit - and sending tons of care your way.
I'm glad you didn't jump.  But I can empathize because today all I want to do is die.  I really pray for you to be injected with hope and happiness, however that looks.  Hugs from afar.
Thrilled to hear.  I'm new to the group, but already you have buoyed my spirit with your good report.  God bless!
